chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, all together from Ibn Mahbub, from al-Haysam ibn Waqid al-Jazari, who said:
I heard Aba Abdillah عليه السلام saying: Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sent a Prophet from among His Prophets to his people, and revealed to him: “Say to your people:”

There are no inhabitants of a town nor any people who were upon My obedience and were granted ease therein, then changed from what I love to what I dislike, except that I change for them from what they love to what they dislike.

And there are no inhabitants of a town nor any household who were upon My disobedience and were afflicted therein by hardship, then changed from what I dislike to what I love, except that I change for them from what they dislike to what they love.
And say to them: ‘My mercy has preceded My wrath, so do not despair of My mercy, for no sin is too great before Me for Me to forgive it.’

And say to them: ‘They must not expose themselves, in stubbornness, to My anger, nor belittle My Awliya’, for indeed I have assaults at the time of My anger that nothing from My creation can withstand.’

key_terms.أَوْلِيَائِي: Allah’s chosen friends and loyal servants
key_terms.رَحْمَتِي: Allah’s mercy, which remains open to the repentant
key_terms.سَطَوَاتٍ: overwhelming acts of seizing or punishment
key_terms.طَاعَتِي: obedience to Allah in conduct and devotion
key_terms.غَضَبِي: Allah’s wrath against persistent rebellion and defiance
key_terms.لَا تَقْنَطُوا: do not despair or lose hope
key_terms.مَعْصِيَتِي: disobedience and sin against Allah’s command

ai.seo_question: How does Allah change a people’s condition according to their obedience, disobedience, and repentance?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that divine blessings and hardships are linked to people’s moral and spiritual state: obedience followed by disobedience leads to loss, while repentance and turning to what Allah loves leads to relief. It also stresses that Allah’s mercy is vast and should never be despaired of, while warning against provoking divine wrath and belittling His Awliya’.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Al haysam Bin Waqad Al Jazry who said, 
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> saying: ‘Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Sent a Prophet<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> from His<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Prophets<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> to his<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> people and Revealed unto him<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>: “Say to your<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> people: ‘
There are none from the inhabitants of a town nor a people who used to be upon My<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> obedience and they attained happiness therein, so they changed over from what I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Love to what I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Dislike, except that I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Changed over for them from what they were loving to what they were dislking.
And there are none from a people of a town nor a family who used to be upon My<sup>azwj</sup> disobedience, so they were hit by harm therein, So they changed over from what I<sup>azwj</sup> Dislike to what I<sup>azwj</sup> Love, except that I<sup>azwj</sup> Changed for them from what they were disliking to what they were loving’.
And say to them: ‘My<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Precedes My<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Anger, therefore do not despair from My Mercy, so there is no sins greater in My<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Presence which I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Forgive’.
And say to them: ‘They should not expose themselves stubbornly to My<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Anger, nor belittle My<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Guardians<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, for Me<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> there are such Assaults during My<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Anger that nothing from My<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> creation can withstand it”.
en.sarwar: 25. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad fand Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father all from ibn Mahbub from al-Haytham ibn Waqid al-Jazari who has said the following: “
I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, sent a prophet to his people and inspired him to tell his people that the Lord says, ‘

There has not been any inhabitants of a town or people who obeyed Me and lived happily and then changed from the condition that 1 loved to what I disliked, but that 1 also changed their condition from what they liked to what they disliked. There has not been any inhabitant of a town or a house who disobeyed Me and were suffering hardships. They then changed their condition from what I disliked to what I loved, I also then changed their condition from what they disliked to what they loved.
Tell them that My favors come before My anger. Do not despair of receiving My favors; sins are not much greater to Me to forgive.
Tell them not to subject themselves stubbornly to My anger and do not consider My friends insignificant; when angry. My striking is insurmountable and no one of the creatures can withstand it.’”
